reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and date-adjustment helpers, but independently implements the daily skip policy in three consumers.

duplication.why: getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange repeat the skip-versus-move decision also implemented in getNextDate.

placement.why: Holiday matching belongs appropriately in shared/schedules.ts, but schedule policy remains embedded in server handlers instead of a shared definition.

scope.why: All edits directly support the requested schedule rules, range handler, configuration field, and associated tests.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate three policy implementations and separate holiday-count-based enumeration bounds when extending schedule behavior.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts: getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange independently enumerate and resolve effective schedule dates alongside shared/schedules.ts:getNextDate.

disguised_duplication.where: The same daily skip-versus-move policy appears as a precomputed flag and find in getNextDate, a null-producing map in getUpcomingDates, and reordered guards in getDatesInRange.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains holidays; getNextDate adds daily-specific branches for occurrence start, take, selection, and adjustment; getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange independently implement the effective-date policy.
